title: A job interview
description: Use the formal pan and pani forms to talk about experience, strengths and availability.

blocks.text: In formal situations Polish uses pan (to a man) and pani (to a woman) with the third-person verb instead of ty: Jakie ma pani doświadczenie? (What experience do you have?). To soften a question or an offer, use the conditional: Kiedy mógłby pan zacząć? (When could you start?). To describe how long you have been doing something, use od with the present tense: od trzech lat pracuję (I have been working for three years).

blocks.translation: Please tell us something about yourself.

blocks.text: Od trzech lat pracuję jako księgowa.
blocks.translation: I have been working as an accountant for three years.
blocks.note: Present tense with od for an action that continues.

blocks.text: Moją mocną stroną jest dobra organizacja.

blocks.translation: I could start from next month.

lines.speaker: Pani Nowak
lines.text: Dlaczego chce pan u nas pracować?
lines.translation: Why do you want to work for us?

lines.speaker: Pan Lis
lines.text: Interesuje mnie rozwój w międzynarodowym zespole.
lines.translation: I am interested in developing in an international team.

lines.speaker: Pani Nowak
lines.text: A jakie są pana oczekiwania finansowe?
lines.translation: And what are your salary expectations?

lines.speaker: Pan Lis
lines.text: Chciałbym zarabiać około ośmiu tysięcy złotych brutto.
lines.translation: I would like to earn about eight thousand zlotys gross.
